annotations.title: Change one channel's autonomy with the expected version

description: Change one channel's autonomy with the expected version. With fast reply on, the assistant handles that channel's messages and starts a plan only when it escalates. A lower threshold gives it more autonomy.

auto_run_enabled.description: Run this channel's plans without waiting for a person when the agent says it would run the plan, all five self-review checks pass and it is at least auto_run_threshold sure. Plans with A/B/C options, money, identity or clinical work always wait for a person. The admin who turns it on is the recorded approver. Default off.

auto_run_threshold.description: How sure the agent must be before a plan runs alone, 0 to 100. Lower means more autonomy. Default 95. Auto-run stays off until enabled.

fast_reply_enabled.description: The assistant answers this channel's messages.

fast_reply_threshold.description: How sure the assistant must be to answer alone, 0 to 100. Lower means more autonomy. Default 50.

idempotency_key.description: Reuse the same key when retrying the same change
